LESSON: GEOMETRICAL CONSTRUCTIONS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Geometry
Topic 4.1: Geometrical Constructions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Geometrical Constructions
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Learning Geometrical Constructions

• Copy every worked example into your book.
• Then solve the Try this questions without looking.

▸ Geometrical Constructions

• Write each step. Box the final answer.

• Step 1: …
• Step 2: …
• Answer: …

Try this

• Solve all three and show working.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Show working for one Geometrical Constructions question.
• Check with a second method.

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Solve 8 practice questions on Geometrical Constructions.
2. Mark and correct mistakes.
